required: legally retrievable or otherwise observable new evidence
residual remaining after exact cache, metadata and period rules, ordinary retrieval, fixed lookup, larger top-k and always-expand controls

missing_condition: Acquire an untouched natural source family with a complete semantic answer reference, legally retrievable missing evidence, and a residual that survives exact cache, metadata/period rules, ordinary retrieval, fixed lookup, larger top-k and always-expand/neighbor controls.

candidates.best_simple_baseline: Deterministic exact visible-role equality: requested_role == candidate_role supports the role binding; any row-label or period mismatch is WRONG_ROLE.

simple_baseline_evidence.strong_role_rule_prior_result: 8/12 overall success and 9/12 correct role decisions
simple_baseline_evidence.final_visible_role_history_result: 5/5 first-attempt success with 0 corrections and 0 role-decision changes

baseline_considerations.exact_cache: Does not create the role decision; can only replay a previously exact task and therefore does not establish a learned residual.
baseline_considerations.metadata_and_period_rules: Period equality plus row-label equality directly identifies all four selected wrong-role failures.
baseline_considerations.ordinary_retrieval_or_fixed_lookup: Not applicable to this visible-table role-binding panel.
baseline_considerations.always_expand_or_direct_answer: Always expand cannot repair a role mismatch after the relevant visible row and period are already present; direct answer without role comparison is a weaker control.

naturalness_and_masking.source_failure_type: Real frozen model failures on program-generated same-number/same-delta role tasks derived from public financial source rows.
naturalness_and_masking.artificial_masking: The collision and expected wrong-role label are constructed by task generation; no real deployment evidence absence is claimed.

rejection_reasons: The negative tasks are authored or program-generated collision fixtures rather than natural post-feedback decision traces.
A deterministic requested-role equals candidate-role rule explains every selected failure and a static strong-role rule already improved the panel.
The existing history collection contains no genuine wrong-role feedback followed by a changed action.

candidates.best_simple_baseline: Ordinary top-3 source retrieval followed by fixed document-paragraph neighborhood closure or a fixed larger top-k lookup.

baseline_considerations.exact_cache: Does not solve first occurrence and is irrelevant to the first-time acquisition slice.
baseline_considerations.metadata_and_period_rules: Could improve ranking, but are dominated here by fixed neighborhood closure that reaches 186/198 at radius 2 and 195/198 at radius 5.
baseline_considerations.always_expand_or_direct_answer: Always radius-5 expansion covers 195/198. Direct answer without acquisition risks unsupported answers and has no verified evidence-acquisition advantage.

naturalness_and_masking.source_failure_type: Controlled table-only interface on a public FinQA snapshot.
naturalness_and_masking.artificial_masking: Source paragraphs are withheld by the controlled interface, but all gold paragraphs remain legally present and retrievable. This is not a natural source-absence claim.

rejection_reasons: All three selected missing paragraphs are recovered by the deterministic fixed action: add immediate paragraph neighbors of official top-3 results.
Across the full text-only slice, fixed top-k or radius expansion explains almost all acquisition headroom.
The interface withholds retrievable source text, so the slice does not prove an independent real-world evidence-acquisition residual.

deterministic_scan.slice_rule: qa.gold_inds is non-empty and every gold key matches text_<integer>.
deterministic_scan.top_k_rule: Use the first k entries of text_retrieved.
deterministic_scan.neighborhood_rule: For each of the first three retrieved paragraph indices, add all paragraph indices within radius r in the concatenated pre_text+post_text sequence.
